title: Family-plus-exception routing under fixed capacity
summary: Compare a shared family expert plus a small learned exception bank with a flat mixture of experts at identical active parameters and routing compute.
hypothesis: A family-plus-exception router will lower worst-group loss by at least 5 percent while using no more active parameters than the flat mixture control.
novelty: The architecture treats regular transformations and residual exceptions as different statistical objects, without assuming that mathematical sporadic groups directly describe the data.
